title: Font Optimisation with next/font
description: Eliminate layout shift and performance hits by loading fonts the right way.

slides.title: The Problem with Web Fonts 🔠
slides.content:
# Flash of Unstyled Text (FOUT) & Layout Shift

Web fonts often load late, causing:

* FOUT: text appears in a fallback font then swaps.
* Layout shift: the page jumps when the font loads because the fallback has different metrics.

Next.js offers `next/font` to fix this. It self‑hosts Google Fonts (or local fonts) and inlines the CSS, so the font is loaded as part of the page request. No extra network round trips!

slides.title: Using Google Fonts (pages/_app.js)
slides.content: Import the font, create a variable, and apply it to the body.

quizData.question: How does `next/font/google` improve performance?

options.text: It downloads fonts from Google's CDN
It self‑hosts the font files at build time, eliminating extra network requests
It defers font loading until user interaction

quizData.explanation: At build time, Next.js downloads the Google font files and serves them from your own domain, along with inlined CSS, preventing layout shift and FOUT.

slides.title: Local Fonts & Variable Fonts 🖋️
Applying Font to Specific Elements (pages/index.js)
slides.content: Use the font on a heading, leaving body with the global font.

quizData.question: Which module do you import to use a font file from your project folder?
quizData.explanation: Use `next/font/local` to load custom font files bundled with your project.

slides.title: Zero Layout Shift ✨
slides.content: `next/font` automatically adjusts font fallback metrics to match the custom font, so the text never jumps. Combined with `next/image`, your page can achieve a perfect 100 Lighthouse score on Core Web Vitals.
